ammonia.reason: Limited amino acid deamination in closed interior without surface mold at 4 months.

animal_barnyard.reason: Raw farm milk p-cresol/indole plus diverse NSLAB from farmstead environment.

bitter.reason: Low hydrophobic bitter peptides; washed curd removes lactose and limits bitter buildup.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti addition and no blue veining; interior anaerobic.

browning.reason: Maillard of residual galactose with free amino acids during heating.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl and acetoin from citrate metabolism by Lactococcus/Leuconostoc starter.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Butyric and hexanoic acids from raw-milk lipase plus starter esterase lipolysis.

creaminess.reason: 48%+ fat-in-dry-matter smooths mouthfeel with moderate proteolysis.

crumbliness.reason: Mid-age limited calcium solubilization; para-casein network still cohesive.

firmness.reason: Pressed washed-curd to ~41% moisture with calcium-phosphate crosslinked casein.

floral_honey.reason: Phenylacetaldehyde and 2-phenylethanol from phenylalanine catabolism by NSLAB.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate and ethyl hexanoate from esterification of acids with ethanol by NSLAB.

goaty.reason: Low caprylic/capric acids in cow milk; no goat branched-chain fatty acids.

malty_nutty.reason: Strecker aldehydes 3-methylbutanal and 2-methylbutanal from leucine/isoleucine catabolism.

melt.reason: pH 5.3 rennet gel with moderate proteolysis flows on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Trace 1-octen-3-ol from raw milk; no bloomy rind flora.

oil_off.reason: Free oil release from ~28% fat coalesced globules on heating.

smoky.reason: Unsmoked make; no wood-smoke phenols such as guaiacol.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic acid from starter plus low acetic acid from heterofermentative NSLAB at pH 5.3.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata hot-water stretching; rennet curd does not align.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Low methanethiol/DMDS from Lactococcus methionine catabolism; no high heat.

sweet.reason: Glycerol and sweet amino acids proline/alanine after lactose depletion.

umami.reason: Glutamate and savory peptides from rennet, plasmin and NSLAB proteolysis.
